trait_scope: Capability for normal capsaicinoid synthesis
species_scope: Capsicum spp.; strongest allele evidence in C. annuum, C. chinense, C. frutescens
model_class: Nuclear Mendelian locus with multiple alleles
inheritance_summary: Functional allele is commonly dominant for presence capability; documented loss-of-function alleles are recessive in studied crosses.

prohibited_claim: Functional Pun1 guarantees a particular SHU or even pungency when other pathway loci are defective.

trait_scope: Vanillylamine production and capsaicinoid accumulation

release_status: MVP eligible for named validated alleles

required_context: Allele identity, species, population, Pun1 and pAMT status.
